title: Styleguide doc definition
description: The `doc/<id>/<id>.yaml` contract. A doc is a styleguide catalogue entry of prose, not a widget. It has no editor fields, no CMS projection and no `kind`. The keys below are the ones parisek/styleguide gives an effect for a doc. It refuses `render` (forwarded to the render only for a component), `responsive` (forced to false for every doc), and `usage`, `category`, `web`, `asana`, `figma` and `drupal` (the SPA shows none of them on a doc route). Shapes shared with page.schema.json are copied, not referenced, and DocSchemaTest keeps the copies identical.

description.description: What this doc is. Shown as the sidebar tooltip and on the overview card.

dev.description: Notes for the DEVELOPER working on this doc. Stays in the YAML: the styleguide does not read it.

body_class.description: Class string the styleguide puts on the render iframe's <body>. For a doc it is the only body class: the styleguide skips the global `iframe.body_class` on doc renders.

variants.description: LEGACY fallback for the display metadata of `styleguide.<variant>.twig` siblings. The primary convention is a `{# title: … description: … #}` comment in the sibling file itself.

multivalueAnnotation.description: Either guidance, or an explicit decision that none is needed. A bare key (`mcp:`, parsing as null) means DELIBERATELY NONE — tooling that reports un-annotated components must stay silent about it, which an absent key cannot express. An empty string and an empty array stay invalid on purpose: they are almost always a half-finished edit, and allowing them would give one decision three spellings.
